text:
rachel: Planning infra apply for release v2.3 - targeted window 03:30 UTC. Scope: provider lock, IAM key rotations, route table updates. Need deploybot gating and a pre-staged tfstate snapshot.

tom: copy. request sequence please.

rachel: sequence: 1) lock provider to 1.2.3, 2) apply module.iam_keys, 3) sleep 5m for token propagation, 4) apply module.routes_add, 5) 10m 20% canary, 6) apply module.routes_shift, 7) smoke tests + release.

miguel: i'll be oncall for the window. set paging to @oncall for sev2+.

secbot: reminder: validate iam lint and run policy-diff. Block if iam:PassRole added.

deploybot: created jobs: plan-10011 (infra/terraform@release/v2.3), apply-10012 (module.iam_keys), apply-10013 (module.routes_add), apply-10014 (module.routes_shift). Manual holds between apply-10012 -> apply-10013 and apply-10013 -> apply-10014. Reply `approve <id>` to proceed.

tom: i'll run apply-10012 at window start and paste summary.

rachel: also, pre-stage snapshot to s3://tfstate/snapshots/infra-v2.3-pre.tfstate and confirm KMS key id in runbook.

miguel: recommend splitting route changes into add vs shift to reduce rollback blast. good to have snapshot ready.

secbot: ran iam-lint: no wildcard principals. policy-diff result: no PassRole. posted to thread.

truncated apply-10012 output from tom: `Apply complete: 5 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed` - IAM keys rotated.

rachel: waiting 5m for clients to refresh tokens.

deploybot: apply-10013 waiting for `approve 10013`.

miguel: route_add applied: `Apply complete: 3 added` - no errors. starting canary at 15% for 10m. watching /health and traces.

rachel: provider lock validated in root module and lockfile.

miguel: canary stable for 12m. proceed to route_shift?

rachel: approve 10014.

deploybot: apply-10014 started by tom. logs: ```applying module.routes_shift... module.routes_shift.aws_route.example: Modifying... [id=rtb-77] Apply complete: 2 changed, 0 destroyed```

tom: smoke tests: `curl -fsS https://api.prod/health | jq .status` -> "healthy". no 5xx.

miguel: saw a brief spike to 1.8% error-rate at t+60s, returned to baseline. flagging for postmortem.

rachel: rollback plan (short): 1) set LB weights back to previous, 2) git checkout <preapply-sha> + terraform apply -target=module.routes_shift, 3) if TF fails, restore tfstate from s3://tfstate/snapshots/infra-v2.3-pre.tfstate.

secbot: i validated S3/KMS permissions and pre-seeded the restore key. dry-restore successful in staging.

rachel: publishing release note: "v2.3 infra: provider pinned to 1.2.3; IAM key rotations; staged route updates with canary; no privilege escalations."

miguel: keeping extra monitoring for 90 minutes. alert thresholds set: error-rate > 2% or p95 > 1.25x baseline will page.

rachel: thanks team, updating playbook with job ids and snapshot path. closing thread."
